summary: Targa Resources Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Targa Resources Partners LP and a bankruptcy-remote SPV entered into a Seventeenth Amendment to their Receivables Purchase Agreement. The amendment extends the facility termination date to July 30, 2027 and establishes an uncommitted $200 million line. Post-amendment, approximately $451 million in trade receivables were outstanding. This is a routine refinancing/extension of an existing securitization facility, not a special situation transaction. No change of control, premium, or strategic event is involved. The filing is standard debt management and warrants no special situation classification.
